query: What are the top innovative trends in Business, Economics, and Management related to airline market analysis, product differentiation, demand estimation, welfare implications, and policy simulations?

response.query: What are the top innovative trends in Business, Economics, and Management related to airline market analysis, product differentiation, demand estimation, welfare implications, and policy simulations?
response.answer: Top trends include yield management, strategic responses to competition, and impact analysis post-COVID-19. Airlines focus on product differentiation and demand estimation for sustainable growth. Policy simulations assess welfare implications and regulatory impacts.

results.title: Market shares on the rise, academic attention ...
results.content: This paper reviews the extant literature on LCCs, categorizing existing studies into seven major themes: general impact/competition, pricing strategies, efficiency, service quality dimensions, regulatory/policy considerations, airport-related aspects and others. (2025) review the airline-within-airline (AWA) strategy, where full-service carriers establish subsidiary low-cost carriers, finding that subsidiary autonomy, labor policy coordination, and flexible route adjustments are key success factors, and identifies the need for further research, especially post-COVID-19. (2019) provide a comprehensive review of passenger satisfaction with in-flight service quality in Indian low-cost carriers, focusing on both business and leisure travelers, and their intention to fly again with the same airlines, while highlighting the lack of studies in emerging markets like India and the prevalent use of SERVQUAL, SERVPERF, and AIRQUAL for measurement, with SEM and Regression Analysis for data analysis. Yadav and Dhingra (2018) systematically reviewed and categorizes 169 articles from 2005–2015 on low cost carriers (LCC) into nine major themes, highlighting the need for future comparative studies on different LCC models worldwide, considering location, policy, regulations, and competition.

results.title: Airline competition: A comprehensive review of recent ...
results.content: # Airline competition: A comprehensive review of recent research. In recent decades, airline competition has received tremendous interest inside the research community, given the competition’s potentially extensive impacts on passengers, economies, and the society as a whole. Our review dissects the more recent literature on airline competition, aiming to comprehensively analyze the diverse perspectives and features that have been reported and investigated to date. Categories covered by our review include passenger choice models, airline service quality, price competition, network competition, airline business models, route entry / exit decisions, hubs and resource limitations, regional airports and markets, as well as studies on concentration and cooperation. In addition, we cover recently emerged studies on the COVID-19 pandemic - devastating to the entire aviation industry - and how the pandemic might have impacted the competition landscape of airlines. Through a comparative analysis of existing methodological papers and case studies, our review offers a comprehensive overview of airline competition in a critical transition phase of aviation, facing severe challenges regarding climate change and sustainability-related development goals.
